_meta.purpose: Find adjacent brands (esp. HK/SG cheongsam) via SimilarWeb similar-sites, seeded from Shanghai Tang / Qipology / Sau Lee
_meta.gating: audience-interests for Shanghai Tang + Qipology = 404 (gated, retried). Yi-ming similar-sites = 404 (below threshold). So discovery relies on similar-sites of the 3 measurable HK brands.

honest_read: similar-sites clusters by AUDIENCE, so the seeds (cheongsam houses) surface a CHEONGSAM/QIPAO/HANFU category cluster (mostly Chinese-diaspora e-com), NOT specifically HK/SG designer houses. Few are HK/SG-headquartered. This IS, however, the competitive set a modern sườn-xám line would sit in. Sau Lee (US-led) additionally surfaces mainstream Western luxury e-com.

new_brands_worth_a_look_for_maison.note: For a true HK/SG DESIGNER-house list, similar-sites is not ideal (audience clusters by category, not HQ). Better = category top-sites filtered to SG/HK, or manual. Offered as next step.
